book.name: 2 TIMOTI
book.title: Timotida luhuwa naba 2 Polokaho je miye

content: Jisesida imi wela wehe loko minatibo ga.
Ipanelika, emoya Jisesi Kalaestitoka woko koludawomuye loko nasahili oletokaka noibomidana ulauya minoko elewole o.

Muki wewenasida domudalo muki nesamuya ilipeko api-napi oetominobo maya maloka wewenamu elideko elewole i-minabo wewena minadeko maya, aya ga maya lo bekadeko ayamidana iki maloka wewenasida api-napi ibitatae.
Emoya Jisesi Kalaestida imi wela wehe loko lolo oko minoko emoki ulana moligitatabomuya osele elamideyo.
Imi wela lolo ikiki yowanula litabo wewenasiya lupamidana yowanulaya lamikilae. Imi wela lolo itae loko dilipe eto ibo we uliki wenipo elideko dowa letiye liki yamidana yowanugoya litae.
Ito lesisi itabokuya we makolimo aya onomidana ujapa wemo lesisi itabomu lo hukaibo gaya auta etiboya, lalo nesala lamekolaiye.
Ito abuha moloko miluma eleko yuhaina etibo welimoya nodenesala o molokadeko omutoko leko niseko nakolaiye.
Sa-ekolaiyo, aya koha moloko ga lo noemobomidana monawa eleko le eto o. We napalimo mulukau le you lokadeko muki nesahenaya ele wehe letane.
Monokamuye loko milumamidana mupilalo ne.
Emoya Jisesi Kalaestidamuya ele-mino. Emoya Dewitida awola helenebokuti aku momoga oko sinaibo weyae loko gala lalo maya lokaka noe.
Sakoya Omaimidana gala lalomuye loko asowalaki nesa ohodanaki miluma elekaka noe. Sa-nodanaki, ulanelo wekidana nala jinitikayoko minoboya, Omaimidana gala maya nala jamabo ne.
Nemoya miluma yowanuya Omailimo dilipe eto ibo wewenamuye loko asowalaki nesaya ohekaka noe. Edimoya Jisesi Kalaestikaho dilipekaka nesa ito elewole lamedalaki nesaya li sa-itae loko sa-okaka noe.
Sa-okaka nonako, ga mako sa-loko neboya wehe loko gaya ne:

content.text: Emo helibokuya kolo mudawokuya emoki magoina minoko leko etune.

Miluma nesa mupilatelo yowibokumuya osele lelamiyoko aha le oheko letudawoya, emoki koloko minoko emo yowanulalo ujapa ekoloune. Emokumuya minamiye loko lemesa metudawoya, emokahoya ayamidana oko emesa lemekolaiye.
Lemoya monokau elewole ametudawoya eimola monowalamu sakoya minamiye loko lametibo nenako, emo aha lonebo galaloya emesalo moloko minakolaiye.

content: Omailimo yowanulalo wewenamu elideko wati etibo ga.

Monoka elebo wewenasiya emo ujapalo minabosiya emoya ga maya le ohatama oko lo bekoko Omaimidana omudaloya sa-loko lo hukoko lo bo: Aha ulawa minametibo gamuya lowa moila hamilo. Aya galimoya eleme-eleme jiki liwa liwa niayoko elebo wewenasida dilipe opa okaka noiye.

Sa-ikaka niayoko noloyo, Omailimo emodamu elideko wati etiye loko abuha moloko minoko yowanu litane. Sa-noko ga ulawa maya le wehe loko lo nobeko yowanukamuya owaka helekaka nesaya yowanulo we mupilakalo yowamekolaiye.
Ga ulawa minametibo gamuya nei nai ga nilideko maya, yamuya emesa bo. Sa-inaboya sa-iliki wiki monokaya hulakilae.
Suwa ganipo maya enemane oko mika ihi napamidana oko minoko muki wewenasitoka maya woko napa ekolaiye. Sa-ekolainako, yamidana weuti makoya uliwa Haimeniyote ito Piletoteyate minaiye.

Edimosiya ga watiya maya eli hulikaidanaki, obohatemoya helenebokuti alo sinokaibo nenako, alikaya ohatama lupaki lilime sinokaka nesa minamiye likaidanaki, monoka elebo wewena malokawasida maya dilipi opa-napa niaiye.
Sa-oneboya, Omaimidana wewenala yuha maya ehada ahoda hi-minabokidana iki minadeko, saina makolimo dilipe momoga amekolaiye. Sa-ikilaboya, edimo lumeyanipoloya Omailimo sa-loko luhuwa jenebo ne:

content.text: We napalimoya eimola wewenala yuhasidaya muda wehe lokaka noiye.

content: Ito makoya sa-loko jenebo maya ne:

content.text: We napamidana ulila li-minabo wewenasiya opa-napa nesanipoya enemane iki huli suwikiki demesa mitae.

content: Uliki we makomidana numudala napauya lape aito-aitomidana goliloti ito siluwaloti lolo abo, ito yadunu ito mikadunu lolo i-minabo ne. Sa-iminaboya, malokaya lalo nesamuya ne, ito malokaya aha amanama nesamuya ne.
Dilipe opa-napa etibo nesa mositabo wewenaya duka ijopa loko lape lalomidana lolo ikadeko, numuda aholalimoya maku beko dilipe nisomao lokadeko, aito aito yowanuya numuda aholamidana litakilae.

We owahasi litaboto maya emesalo molamoko mino oli o. Sa-okoko emoki ito obohanipo ijopa lo-minadeko Omaidamu wako wako liki ju liki minikaka niabo wewenakiya wehe liki eli elewole iki duka biki hulu iki minatune liki dabuha molalo.
Lowa moila hikaka ga nei ga likaka nesamidana maya oli hekadeko wideyo. Aya gamidana ihilawa maya lowa lowa okaka nesa maya neboya alo ele-minane.
We napamidana yowanulalo wewenasiya aya gaya ligi hagi iki lowa moila hamiki, muki wewenasidaya elewole gauti lamiki monokaya dowa liki huluguti li bitae.

Edimosiya limiki miniki monokamidana ulalalo wewenasida maya dilipi wehe litae. Sa-idekoya, Omailimo eimola dilipe-loko nisekadeko, obohanipo li wili jiki Omaimidana ga lalowama mudai wehe litahe liki sa-ikilae.
Sa-ideko monokamidana ulalalo wewenasida data maya aku golotokadeko, olohamidana elehulauti maya dilimekadeko Omailimo letibotoka molatibotoka iki minatae.
